title: Fix rejected drain PR #181 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-119)
description:
Drain PR #181 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-119`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-119 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-119`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-119` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- [major] Scope creep: The PR modifies docs/curriculum-conformance.md to add 'agents/cron-schedule.json' to owner lists — this is outside the task scope which only specifies changes to tests/curriculum-conformance.test.mjs — Remove the documentation changes and focus only on the test file as specified in the task
- [major] Incorrect task status update: The PR modifies tasks/queue/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-119.json to set claimedBy and add metadata — task queue management is outside the scope of this test implementation task and should be handled by the queue system — Revert the task file changes and let the queue system handle task status updates
- [minor] Fragile regex pattern: The SCHEDULE_RE pattern uses \b word boundaries which may miss some legitimate scheduling terms in different contexts — Consider using a more robust pattern or adding additional validation for edge cases — Review and potentially expand the regex pattern to handle more scheduling terminology variations
